sources.quote: It is pronounced and has the Bayer designation Beta Andromedae, which is Latinized from β Andromedae.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 1,404 times the Sun's luminosity at 3,802 K, so 86.471 solar radii.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Mirach"
sources.quote: This star is positioned northeast of the Great Square of Pegasus and is potentially visible to all observers north of latitude 54° S. It is commonly used by stargazers to find the Andromeda Galaxy.
